name: run_mac_command
description: Ask to run a command on the active turn sender's connected Mac. Approval stays on that Mac.

name: create_workspace
description: Create a workspace with this workspace's owner and start its first message. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. Omitted model and effort use the owner's defaults. Fast mode requires explicit fast: true for a marked model. The reply gives the workspace number and link, and the first session link. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.

name.description: Optional workspace name. Use plain words separated by spaces. Avoid underscores unless the user tells you to add them. The app keeps the first line, without a final full stop, cut to 60 characters at a word.

firstSessionTitle.description: Optional first session title. Use plain words separated by spaces. Avoid underscores unless the user tells you to add them.

sectionId.description: A section ID from list_sections. Omission uses the default section.

requestId.description: Keep this ID to retry without another workspace, session, or message. Omission generates an ID.

fast.description: Use fast mode for a marked model. Creates default to false. Omission on send keeps the session speed.

name: list_workspaces
description: List workspaces with their number, link, name, branch, state, and owner ID, login, and display name. Needs only the workspace token. Without filters or paging, returns every workspace, including archives. Use the actual message sender's member ID for their workspaces. Find another owner's ID in returned owner fields. Do not infer the owner from the token or active turn. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.

ownerId.description: A stable member ID from the actual message Sender line or workspace owner fields. A login is not an ID.

updatedSince.description: Signed safe-integer epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Select newer activity.

archived.description: Select archived workspaces with true, or other workspaces with false.

limit.description: Maximum entries. A limited reply gives hasMore. Omission returns every entry.

offset.description: Entries to skip before the next page.

name: get_workspace
description: Get workspace details, including owner, repository, base branch, section, activity, and restore times. Needs only the workspace token. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.

workspaceId.description: A workspace ID from list_workspaces or a returned link. Defaults to the calling workspace.

Acts for the member whose message started that turn. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. name: list_repositories
description: Needs only the workspace token. List the repositories that create_workspace accepts, with their IDs. current marks this workspace's repository.

name: list_sections
description: Needs only the workspace token. List this org's sections in sidebar order, with their IDs. default marks the section that create_workspace uses when it names none.

name: list_models
description: Needs only the workspace token. List the models that the app offers, with their agents, efforts, and boolean fast marks, and the standard-speed default choice that create_workspace uses when it names no model.

name: read_session
description: Read the Markdown transcript of an open or closed session, including an archived workspace. Needs only the workspace token. Defaults to concise and the newest text. For earlier text, set startLine and startOffset. Use next.line and next.offset for the following read. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.

workspaceId.description: A workspace ID from list_workspaces or a returned link. Defaults to the calling workspace.

sessionId.description: A session ID from list_sessions or a session link.

startLine.description: One-based start line. Zero selects line one.

startOffset.description: UTF-16 offset within the start line. Defaults to zero when a line is given.

name: create_session
description: Create a session in this org for the sender of the active calling turn. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. Omitted model or effort uses that sender's saved default, then the app default. Fast mode requires explicit fast: true for a marked model. Without firstMessage, creates an empty session. A first message can queue a workspace start. The reply keeps acceptance and reports resume status. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.

requestId.description: Keep this ID to retry without another workspace, session, or message. Omission generates an ID.

title.description: Optional session title. Use plain words separated by spaces. Avoid underscores unless the user tells you to add them. The app keeps the first line, cut at 60 characters at a word.

fast.description: Use fast mode for a marked model. Creates default to false. Omission on send keeps the session speed.

name: send_message
description: Send text to a session in this org for the sender of the active calling turn. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. An omitted choice keeps the session's model, effort, and fast mode. The message joins a running turn, or opens a linked session when the sender cannot use its starter's login. The reply gives the actual receiving session, message, turn, and resume status. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.
